Team —

Quick regional pulse as finance locks the Q4 forecast next week. I attached the consolidated commit sheet (EMEA_APAC_Q4_commit_sheet_v2.xlsx) — please do the following by EOD Tuesday (09/14):

I’ll run a short rollup on Wednesday morning and flag any large gaps. If you need help reconciling the sheet, ping me and we’ll set a 20-min triage.
